product.title: Costa Brava Day Adventure: Kayak, Snorkel & Cliff Jump with Lunch

description.text: In Barcelona, the gorgeous coastline of Costa Brava is best experienced from the water. Discover the crystal-clear Mediterranean Sea while kayaking to coves and small caves, and snorkel for a better glimpse of marine life. Stops include Costa Brava, Mediterranean coves, Costa Brava Sea Caves. This day trip takes you by coach from central Barcelona to a picturesque beach, where kayak guides share their expertise. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
